Home/About

Mercantile started as a single rack of tees in the back of a gear shop: the kind of shirt you bought because it would survive the drive home, not because of the logo on it. Everything we make still follows that rule.

No warehouse, no committee. Just a Minnesota guy who got tired of tees that didn't hold up, and decided to cut his own.

Every run is still small-batch: cut, dyed, and finished within a few miles of where it started, checked by hand before it ships anywhere.

Core Styles, No Filler

Three rules we don't break.

I.

Make it heavier than it needs to be

A tee that's too light tears, pills, and goes see-through in a year. We start at 6.5oz and go up from there. You'll feel the difference on the first wear.

II.

Fix it, don't replace it

Every Mercantile tee carries a lifetime repair promise. Blown-out seam, faded print, worn collar: send it back and we'll make it right instead of selling you a new one.

III.

Small runs, on purpose

We'd rather sell out of a color than sit on a warehouse of overstock. Every batch is small enough that someone still checks it by hand.

"Buy less. Wear it longer. Repair it when it breaks. That's the whole business model."
